body.p: Alpha paragraph starts here and continues with enough words so the reflow engine wraps it across several visual lines on a typical page width. Soft join should turn those wraps into spaces when the user copies text, not hard newlines in the middle of the sentence.

Bravo paragraph is a second block. Soft join must keep a real newline between Alpha and Bravo so paragraphs stay separate, while still joining wraps inside this second paragraph itself across multiple visual lines of body text on the page.

Charlie paragraph ends the sample. More filler words pad the line so reflow wraps: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen twenty.
